title: Normalization by a literal coherent stage morphism
statement: For any proof of coherence of the prescribed rational pullbacks and normalized stage comparisons, the functor of the resulting literal stage morphism is the specified common-stage derived pullback.

source.place: Compatibility; finite-stage representative and supplied-operation normalization.

proof.text: Normalized descent supplies such an identity for one coherence proof. Proof irrelevance identifies its coherence field with the supplied proof, so the same literal stage morphism has the required functor identity.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility; explicit finite-model and scalar-unit cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem commonProjectionPullbackStageNormalization
    (hc : StageSystem.pairFunctorCoherent (stageSystem l Ω Y) (stageSystem l Ω X)
      (fun L ↦ rationalDerivedPullback l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient l Ω L) f)
      (commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω f)) :
    commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f =
      (commonProjectionPullbackStages l Ω f hc).functor
